name: campusconnect
description: CampusConnect - A Verified, Student-Driven Digital Campus Ecosystem

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "SERVER,CLIENT" -c "blue,green" "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix server run build && npm --prefix client run build && npm run build:sync
scripts.vercel-build: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install && npm --prefix server run build && npm --prefix client run build && npm run build:sync
scripts.postinstall: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.test: npm --prefix server test && npm --prefix client test
